exposure: Laparoscopic management of caesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) using a 10-step systematic approach
outcome: Efficacy of laparoscopic management of CSP
Postoperative uterine reconstruction (ultrasonic measurement of isthmic myometrial layer thickness)
cohort: The participants are patients with caesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who have an indication for laparoscopic treatment.
finding: The presented 10-step laparoscopic technique is effective for treating CSP, removing uterine isthmocele, and reconstructing the lower uterine segment, demonstrated by an increase in myometrial wall thickness from 3 mm preoperatively to 13 mm three months postoperatively in a presented case.
